title: Adaptive intake, pinning, and profiling pipeline for heterogeneous OSS LLMs
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Deliver an end-to-end intake pipeline that accepts heterogeneous community weights (PyTorch, safetensors, GGML, ONNX), performs deterministic conversion and reproducible fingerprinting, runs safety and license scans, generates a runtime-compatible bundle, and publishes a versioned pin + performance profile. Goal is to reduce manual steps for model owners and make admission decisions auditable and reversible.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline accepts at least PyTorch, safetensors, GGML-lite, and ONNX formats and produces a canonical runtime bundle
Generated pin is content-addressable and stable across deterministic conversion runs (bit-identical pin for same source and conversion config)
Performance profile includes latency P50/P95 for short and long context, memory footprint, quantization-friendly flags, and a recommended default kernel set
Automated license and safety scan runs and flags failures into an 'requires-review' queue
Artifacts (bundle, profile, manifest) are published to the model catalog with provenance links and smoke test badges
Rollback path exists to unpin a model and restore prior serving variant within the console
steps: 1) Accept upload: signed manifest with source URL, checksum, license metadata
2) Pre-scan: run license detector, safety heuristics, and weight sanity checks
3) Conversion matrix: choose converter chain based on source format and target runtime (torch->onnx->ggml fallback for memory-constrained targets)
4) Deterministic conversion: run conversion in hermetic environment with pinned toolchain and record conversion log
5) Fingerprint: produce content-addressable pin (sha256) that covers source + transformation recipe
6) Profile: run smoke (functional) tests, micro-bench latency runs at 8/128/2048 tokens, memory measure, and quantization probe
7) Publish: register bundle, profile, and pin to catalog; annotate with provenance and CI badge
8) Post-check: trigger canary deploy job for dedicated tier and capture metrics for 24h before marking as 'certified'
comments: 2025-11-06 - Ava Martinez: Kickoff meeting notes uploaded to Confluence; agreed to support GGML-lite as an opt-in conversion target for edge customers.

2025-12-02 - Ravi Patel: Prototype deterministic conversion run completed for llama-3-small; observed non-determinism in weight ordering from upstream tarball — added normalization step to manifest extraction.
2026-01-18 - Priya Shah (Security): License scanner now flags ambiguous licenses (e.g., dual-licensed with unclear redistribution) and attaches required_review tag.
2026-02-02 - QA: Smoke suite expanded with temperature/stochastic seed control; added reproducibility check for sampling outputs.

2026-02-20 - Ravi Patel: Performance profiling harness integrated with perf-lab infra; P95 for 2048 tokens on the test GPU is stable but memory footprint spikes under quant-ptq flow — tracking in sub-issue ENG-100254.
decisions: Use a two-stage canonicalization: (a) manifest normalization (order keys, strip non-deterministic metadata), (b) byte-level reserialization of tensors using little-endian canonical order
Primary pining scheme will be sha256(source_tarball) + sha256(conversion_recipe) concatenation to ensure collision resistance and traceability
Adopt ONNX as intermediate for graph-preserving converters when possible; fallback to GGML for memory-optimized bundles
Profile artifacts will include both native runtime numbers and 'equivalent' budgeted numbers (what the model would look like when quantized) to help routing decisions
risks: Upstream weight bundles with non-deterministic metadata can cause repeated pin churn; mitigation: enforce canonical extraction and publish conversion logs
License ambiguity could block automation and require manual legal review, slowing onboarding throughput
Memory regressions from automated quantization probes could cause failed canaries if not gated behind a staging rollout
Large model conversion runs are expensive; need cost accounting and autoscaling for the conversion service
notes: This ticket is intended to consolidate multiple prior onboarding efforts into a single, auditable flow that supports hybrid conversion strategies and deterministic pin creation. Focus on traceability and observability so SRE and Legal can review without rerunning heavy conversions.
